findings.title: Apply the website visibility restriction to website_name
findings.body: The new website_name attribute is not included in untrusted_attributes, and include_website_name lacks the trailing '?' required for a serializer inclusion predicate. Consequently, an anonymous viewer of a TL0 user receives the website hostname (and, for matching domains, its path) even when scope.restrict_user_fields? suppresses website. The template also displays this leaked value because it now checks website_name independently. Apply the same restriction as website and add a test with a populated TL0 website.
